note: Both sets capture the figure's component labels and the red-channel-beneath-blue-channel placement identically, and both misread the phase screw dislocation as e^{iθ} where the page shows e^{ilθ}. Set B additionally extracts the supported trade-off that IWA grows with higher topological charge, which Set A omits despite it being a key engineering statement on the page. Both sets also duplicate the input-beam fact under two attribute names and both leave out the companion trade-off (higher charge lowers sensitivity to low-order aberrations).
remarks: Both sets render the dislocation form as e^{iθ}; the text layer garbles it as 'eilθ' and the image shows e^{ilθ} (topological charge l), so the exponent's l is dropped in both. The 'Input beam from FSM' fact appears twice per set (as 'component' and 'input source'). Most figure-derived claims are bare component labels with no attribute values; the substantive quantitative content on this page is the IWA/low-order-aberration trade-off with topological charge, of which only half (IWA) is captured, and only by Set B.
